## Legs: run vs queued

### The engineering legs — RAN (offline, no ADC, no network)

- **`ops/gcp/seed-declared-jobs.sh` (new, ~750 lines)** — the ONE
  authorized seed path, deliberately narrow. It is NOT
  `scheduled-ops.sh`: no fleet reconcile, no update path, no upsert —
  an existing target job or trigger refuses the leg outright.
  - Closed contract: the twelve-row table is pinned verbatim in the
    script AND re-verified against `ops/cadence.toml` at every
    invocation — a changed cron/timeout/name, a missing row, an extra
    `r11-*` batch or tribal screened-lane source, an `existing` mark or
    a declared `secrets` list all refuse (exit 2).
  - Image: the contract pin
    `sig-api@sha256:6ad5477d4aacde23d508f5eea765a6ad835e603ad794b10df56710acca4414f5`
    only; `SIG_JOB_IMAGE` unset → the pin; a same-repo digest must
    equal it; a same-repo tag must resolve to it at apply; a foreign
    repo, `:latest`, a bare ref, or any other digest refuses (ADR-111).
  - Temporary identity: every deploy runs as
    `<projectNumber>-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com` (resolved
    live at apply) and is labelled
    `runtime-identity=temporary-default-compute`; the interim
    default-compute/`sig-ingest-rt` drift on exactly these twelve jobs
    is expected state owned by `P34.42b-live-2`, recorded not hidden.
  - Apply order per row (contract § Production mutations): re-check
    job+trigger absence → `run jobs deploy` →
    `add-iam-policy-binding` (`sig-scheduler` `roles/run.invoker`) →
    `scheduler jobs create http` (declared cron, `Etc/UTC`, the job's
    `:run` URI, oauth `sig-scheduler`) → `scheduler jobs pause` →
    `state=PAUSED` read-back before the next row.
  - Fail path: any create-ok/pause-fail or mid-leg appearance aborts
    and rolls back ONLY this leg's creations (`created.txt` replay:
    triggers → bindings → jobs); `--apply rollback` replays the same
    manifest on demand — a pre-existing resource is never touched.
  - Evidence: `--evidence-dir DIR` captures AR-2 prestate (jobs list,
    scheduler list, `sig-scheduler` SA, project number, restricted-
    bucket + `sig-pg-password` IAM, per-target absence describes,
    no-executions reads, `date -u` + branch/sha stamps), the apply
    transcript, `created.txt`, the poststate (job/trigger describes,
    executions, the 100-count check) and `sha256  <relpath>` sidecars.
  - Window: apply exits 42 (queued, re-run prompt printed) outside a
    weekday 14:00–20:00Z slot; check/rollback are never window-gated.
- **`tests/ops/test_seed_declared_jobs.py` (new, 28 tests)** — the
  offline harness: a fake `gcloud` on `PATH` + fixture `cadence.toml`
  copies drive `--apply` end-to-end without ADC/network; covers the
  closed set (12/12 rows), cadence-drift refusal ×8, digest
  enforcement ×5, the compute-SA + label, mutation ordering
  (job→binding→trigger→pause→PAUSED), existing-job/trigger refusal,
  running-execution refusal, pause-failure rollback scoping, explicit
  `--apply rollback`, the out-of-window exit-42 queue, evidence-dir
  contents, no `jobs execute`/`scheduler run`/`resume`, and exact
  12/12/12/12 mutation counts.
- **`ops/gcp/config.sh`** — the `SIG_SEED_STATE_DIR` block (env-
  overridable; no literal project id).
- **`ops/gcp/README.md`** — the script's contract row (one-line
  runbook).
- **`tests/ops/test_gcp_iac.py`** — the script joins `SHELL_SCRIPTS`,

- **`docs/build/tools/return_pass.py`** — `TICKET_ID_RE` widened to
